criterion_text: (Agent discovery): Real delegated child cgroup catalog exposes actual configurables; no synthetic four-key allowlist. Offline/macOS show unknown/unsupported honestly; no foreign cgroup or process mutation during discovery.

verifiers.summary: The Agent derives cgroup controller files from its real delegated child, not a synthetic allowlist, and reports unavailable states truthfully

evidence.value: the real Agent discovered 24 declarative controller files: cpu.idle, cpu.max, cpu.max.burst, cpu.uclamp.max, cpu.uclamp.min, cpu.weight, cpu.weight.nice, cpuset.cpus, cpuset.cpus.exclusive, cpuset.cpus.partition, cpuset.mems, io.max, io.prio.class, io.weight, memory.high, memory.low, memory.max, memory.min, memory.oom.group, memory.swap.high, memory.swap.max, memory.zswap.max, memory.zswap.writeback, pids.max
cgroup.procs/threads/kill/freeze/subtree_control, read-only state and memory.reclaim were absent from the catalog
discovery left no .probe- child behind and two authenticated reads returned identical measured fields
exact tests proved macOS/backend-missing catalogs never claim a fabricated supported file set
